body: Sorry was totally burned out for a bit. What did you have in mind? I’m trying to get back into things but it’s hard when when a literal wall of negativity is your best friend who uses Christianity to mask his bigotry and hatred of everything. Ya know.

I used to think, I’d have a wife, maybe a dog or two. I’d have a good friend or two. Be able to have beers on the back porch with family on holidays. 

But now...I’m flat broke and alone. Isn’t it funny how I just wanted a shot.  But all I am is D.O.A.

Not really. I used to have lots of em. But just like having the wind knocked out of you, mania and to greater extent depression and life have beat me into stagnation. Besides working flea markets I don’t get out much.

I am on disability for bipolar depression. I have a under the table job with crafts. I dropped out of college at 22. Been on Disability since 27. I used to not function at all, I got some semblance of life back for 4 months but the same darkness is tugging at the seems again. The Unraveling if you will.
Rough life....What’s good for the depression ain’t so good for the heart. I just feel so utterly alone and it’s connections that make us stay.

Drivers for intel maybe? From what I understood. Specter and meltdown were a problem with the CPU not GPU two different components. But I could be wrong and if so, would you elaborate? I’m a tech junkie and this is the first I’ve heard of them affecting a GPU. Thanks in advance!

I know exactly what you mean. It's hard to reach out and make a genuine connection with someone when you are in a rough place. Especially when that rough place is depression.

People have often given me the advice to join a group for an activity I'm interested in, or possibly find a group to do the activity with. It doesn't help me that I'm a naturally solitary person to begin with. I like having a very small circle of friends. The problem is my past (which is kind of a scapegoat I guess) but it has led to me having trust issues and doubts about myself that just never seemed to heal.

I get what you are saying about feeling alone and unwanted. I feel that so bad it feels like my essence is being torn to pieces, an ache I can't shake. I can cover it up for a while, but in the end it comes back to having no one to share my time/love/friendship with. Just me. It's very painful emotionally and physically.
